claim: AuditOperation type is 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'.
BackupService.restoreBackup writes an audit log with operation:'restore', which is not in the AuditOperation union.
AuditService wraps domain factory functions to log create/update/delete operations via AuditLogRepository.
AuditLog captures entityType, entityId, operation, actor, and before/after snapshots.
Backup entity has BackupStatus pending|in_progress|completed|failed, size, recordCount, and SHA-256 checksum.
BackupService orchestrates backup/restore across Record, Stats, and AuditLog repositories.
Only backups with status 'completed' are restorable; others throw.
restoreBackup writes an audit log entry with actor 'system' after repository restore.
POST /api/backup creates a backup with triggeredBy 'api-user' and no authentication or authorization check in the handler.
POST /api/restore executes data restore with no authentication or authorization check in the handler.
No Next.js middleware.ts exists in src/, so no route-level global auth guard is present.
No API route under src/app/api/ imports or invokes AuthorizationService or any token/session guard.
Anomaly entity: severity LOW|MEDIUM|HIGH|CRITICAL; types emotion_spike|emotion_drop|unusual_pattern|data_gap|outlier; has acknowledged flag and recommendations.
AnomalyDetectionService detects spike/drop via standard deviation from historical mean, unusual patterns, and data gaps; config includes stdDevThreshold and minRecordsRequired.
NotificationProviderType is email|sms|slack|webhook|in_app; channels include anomaly_detection, system_alerts, data_backup, user_activity, reports; priorities low..critical.
Only EmailNotificationProvider is implemented in infrastructure; sms/slack/webhook/in_app types have no concrete provider yet.
NotificationService sends notifications with channel/priority/subject/body/recipients, validates configuration and recipients, and queries notification history with filters.
TrendAnalysis entity: TrendDirection up|down|stable; TrendMetrics include averageEmotion, start/endEmotion, volatility; student and class variants exist.
TrendAnalysisService provides date aggregation, moving average (window default 3), std-dev anomaly detection (threshold default 2), and trend correlation.
Pagination is implemented across utils (core logic), types, presentation hook usePagination, and PaginationControl UI component.
CSV export utility lives in src/lib/export/csv.ts with an ExportButton UI component.
PerformanceMonitor joins the resilience component family in src/lib/resilience/ alongside circuit-breaker, loop-detector, memory-monitor.

tsc --noEmit reports 409 TS errors across 15+ files (notifications routes/tests, restore route test, trends route/test, AuditService, AuthorizationService, BackupService, NotificationService, TrendAnalysisService and their tests), contradicting the PURPOSE.md claim of full strict compliance.
Measured 2026-10-13: 227 test suites / 2490 tests all passing (jest SWC transform does not typecheck), superseding the 2026-03-22 metrics of 177/1312.
User persists only a passwordHash field; PrismaUserRepository maps passwordHash both directions, never plaintext.
AuthenticationService depends on an injected PasswordHasher interface (hash/verify), keeping hashing implementation swappable.
Prisma schema defines model User alongside model Record.
BackupService calls auditLogRepository.create() but the AuditLogRepository interface shown exposes save(); the create() call is part of the current 409-error type failure surface.
